selection: First construction seed in every condition, without performance-based selection. Visualize all five episodes of round0 for each L0; analyze all 3000 saved episodes/model.
time_convention: Frames t=0 initial state, t=k state after kth simultaneous action, 1-based event times. A cue created at t can first influence decision t+1.
cue: First visible state change (position or cooked status) of any right-side ingredient relative to reset. In partial view it must reach the shared divider; in full view the first observed pickup can reveal L0's selection.
waiting_measure: Longest consecutive unchanged left-chef pose/holding/left-food state before its first raw-food pickup and before the first observable right-food change. Descriptive only, not evidence of intent.
